reviews.t: Just like old school pipe tobacco!!!!
reviews.x: I was given a sample of this from the department store to bring home. I'm giving it five stars for a reason. This scent smells exactly like pipe tobacco. If you want to smell like pipe tobacco there is nothing better out there. This cologne is as powerful as it gets. I can't imagine using more than two sprays, and that easily lasts all day. The initial spray of this juice is supremely powerful. I didn't like it at first, but after about an hour it starts to smell pretty good. This scent really g

reviews.t: Something is Terribly Wrong with This Parfum
reviews.x: Do not buy from this vendor!!! I spent $308 dollar for 1.7 ounces of Tom Ford's famous Tabacco Vanille. I've had it before; it's a really strong fragrance, beautiful in fact. What I received barely has a scent. I repeatedly contacted their customer service and got the run around for a week. Now I'm convinced that this dealer is trying to sell counterfeit fragrances and will not stand by their product. DO NOT BUY FROM THIS DEALER. THEY ARE CONNING YOU AND THINK YOU'RE TOO STUPID TO KNOW THEY ARE

reviews.t: Sweet, lovely, smells just like the name
reviews.x: I am not an impulse buyer. So before I spend $$$ on a parfum, I did some extensive research. First, I knew I wanted to have a Tom Ford because of his reputation in making parfum. Then I narrowed down the choices to the 5 most preferred private blends by online reviewers. Then I bought .5ml sample for each. After trying them one by one, my husband made the choice for me: Noir de Noir, but my favorite is Amber Absolute.  Vanilla Tobacco is really sweet and nice, with straight forward vanilla tabac

It doesn't smell anything like what you will find in stores. It smells disgusting, like mold and dust that has been sitting for awhile. If you really love the scent, buy it in store to get an authentic scent. I wouldn't recommend purchasing this online like I did because it's so easy to fake or buy an expired scent. Don't risk having your money stolen like me because this is not returnable. It's either expired, or was never real to begin with, but either way, AVOID IT.
This is just the best Fragrance that I Have ever brought . Highly recommend this to any one who loves the smell of tobacco

This is by far the best smelling cologne I've ever smelled. I normally don't bother writing reviews but this is worth it. It smells expensive, elegant and manly and I don't regret buying it and will buy again! Lasts all day long on skin and for days on clothes, at times I can smell it in the shower after a long day and on clothes even after washing them. Got lots of compliments but mainly I love it myself. My favorite and definitely recommend it!

reviews.t: You're trying to charge me 2x the price of retail??
reviews.x: This is the most amazing cologne I've ever smelled.
Smells terrific and got it quickly in mail.  A bit disappointed that the bottle was not larger for price. But still great price.

The smell lingers all day and even while showering you smell it wafting all over the shower. It has a great unisex vanilla laced with a woodsy/tobacco slightly earthy undertone. Definitely on the sweeter side and gets compliments from the lady’s. All it takes is one spritz and there’s plenty to last throughout the day. The smell even transfers to your shirt collar...for a nice surprise when doing laundry😁 I would definitely purchase again...but, buyer beware as I believe that there are counterfe
The smell is a rich combination of vanilla & Tobacco.  The scent easily lasts all day and isn’t overwhelming and offensive to others.

I've been looking for unique scents like this -- i.e. that aren't the typical 'old-school, manly' scent, but are warm and semi-sweet.  I've leaned toward the Paco Rabanne 1 Million (both versions), as well as a handful of Theiry Mugler scents -- finding they've all been the warm, sweet (more like vanilla sweet, not candy sweet).  Those have been my go-to scents thus-far.  This though, is quite possibly the best scent I've found.  It's warm like vanilla, but not like a teenager -- it still has an

This cologne smells like what I think Old Spice ought to.  It does not, however, smell like pipe smoke.  For that, you'd need to apply the cologne after immersing yourself in aromatic pipe smoke.  This fragrance smells like a heady combination of vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and cedar. I think a lot of people associate the smell of a pipe with the spicy colognes that pipe-smoking men of yesteryear would wear.  Use it sparingly, as a little goes a long way.

Every time I wear this at least one person mentions how great I smell. One guy said I smelled like a stripper he knew, others say it smells like a well worn leather jacket, or their grandfathers cigars. To each their own, I just enjoy the attention.
I’m a big fan of Tom Ford fragrances.  This is my first Tobacco Vanilla, and I find it to be irresistible.  It is sophisticatedly sensuous.  Usually pricey but worth every drop.
Perfect so glad Amazon sells this particular scent as this is my youngest sons favorite. He fell in love with this while living in Australia for awhile. Well done Amazon.
Thank you for a wonderful perfume and friendly customer service!

reviews.t: For the right guy or not?
reviews.x: Smells nice but only for the right man at the right place. It's a sophisticated, classy upscale scent. A blue collar worker or teenage Abercrombie/Hollister, Yeti Cooler and light bar kind of guy couldn't pull it off (Stick with Polo Red or Abercrombie Fierce if you're in that category). It would confuse everyone. The kind of guy that pulls this cologne off is either in a suit, nice dress shirt and slacks or womanizer grandpa during the fall and winter. Never wear this in the summer or in a t-sh

I ordered this cologne after winning a handsome sum playing the lottery. I was shopping for a new scent to accompany my new lifestyle and seen this one online. After seeing the black bottle with gold accents, I knew this was the one. A few days later, I received the cologne; upon opening the package, I already began to feel entitled. I spritzed the cologne twice, just to get a sense of what my new lifestyle would smell like. To my surprise, I began to perspire, my heart raced, and my stomach cra

Oh my! Oh my!! I love this! I love smelling this on me and I find myself seriously turned on when my husband wears it too- on me, I can't stop sniffing my wrist! On him, I can't stop kissing his neck and face!! WINNER WINNER WINNING!

This isn't a good or strong smell! And I'm not picky this is maybe worth 40 dollars max not 240 dollars
This is my all time favorite. I’ve always worn Creed but now I’m Tom Ford

reviews.t: BEWARE! Smells like Marijuana Smoke not Leather!
reviews.x: This stuff smells STRONGLY like stale marijuana smoke rather than leather!  :(  Sorry but I just cannot walk around smelling like a college kid's apartment after a weekend of cheetos, video games, and bong hits. This is sad because the dry down has a great smell... but it takes hours for it to kick in and you still have the stale marijuana smoke base smell the entire time.  So basically the dry down tones smell like a great cologne trying to mask marijuana smoke on your clothes.  That's messed u

reviews.t: Great scent, but no way am I going anosmic to it this quickly.
reviews.x: It's a terrific scent. Especially during the colder months. But as far as the strength, there's no way I'm going noseblind to it within 5 minutes of applying it. This scent is known to be strong and a "2 spray max", but within a few minutes of spraying it, it seems to be nothing more than a skin scent on me. No other fragrance have I applied and lost the scent of it so quickly. Not sure if I received a stale bottle or what, but it's not living up to the strength and sillage hype I expected.

This is the only cologne I've ever gotten excited about. I can't stop snuggling my husband's neck when he puts this on.  This is seriously the best cologne I have ever smelled. I had a hard time at first justifying the expense but am so glad I bought it. My husband really likes it, too.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent as a rich, sweet tobacco and vanilla fragrance that smells exactly as described.
Many reviewers say the fragrance lasts all day on skin and even lingers on clothes and in the shower.
Several reviewers report receiving a product that barely smells or smells moldy/dusty, suggesting it may be fake or expired.
Reviewers note the fragrance draws compliments and attention from others.
Some reviewers feel the price is high relative to the bottle size, though others consider it worth the cost.
